interpretation: Previously inspected four-window evaluations with constructed fixed celestial pointings; not an observing schedule, detections, or independent population trials.
legacy_metadata: The pre-run protocol copies old window registry notes verbatim. Their held-out wording is historical metadata, not evidence of untouched v2 evaluation data.
boundary_diagnostic: Near-boundary means absolute peak-minus-half-power margin at most 1e-8, matching the scorer's tangency tolerance. This flags classification sensitivity even when a tiny interval is reported. Frozen classifications are retained.
